title: 第11章 丹劫吵老家伙更吵第12章 大白不是小白鼠
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
从接待弟子口中说出的话，无一不在刺激分会会长的神经，尤其是二长老听到自己儿子的所作所为就知道会长绝对不会放过他，最后他们听到史思明居然想要这位天穹境大能陪他一晚？二长老差点当场昏死过去。
“岂有此理，真是岂有此理！
我炼丹师协会怎么会出现这样的败类？”
“二长老，这就是你教的好儿子！”
分会会长当场就直接把二长老抽进了废墟之中，二长老口吐鲜血片刻不敢耽搁，直接飞柳雨柔的面前拼命磕头。
剩下那几个狗腿的师傅，也相继跑到柳雨柔面前赔礼道歉。
“道歉有用还要那些条条框框来干嘛？你们自己看着办！”
史思明做梦都没想到居然惹了这样的大佬，竟然还想要穹天境的美女陪自己一晚。
分会会长亲自动手当场杀了史思明，二长老和剩下那些史思明的狗腿被废掉修为逐出炼丹师协会。
“快去把前辈需要的药材都拿过来，前辈这是您要的离阳木，那些药材和离阳木都免费送给前辈当做我们炼丹师协会赔礼，前辈还有什么需要尽管说，我们尽全力满足！”
分会会长想着尽全力满足青墨的要求，只希望他能消气，倘若再能结个善缘那就更好了！
“一码归一码，本公子不白拿你们的药材，该给你们的灵石一块都不会少，至于这离阳木嘛！
本公子拿一份丹方来换。”
“不敢，不敢这本来就是我们炼丹师协会的过失，这些都是应该的。”
“行了别啰嗦了我怎么说，你就怎么做！”
青墨白了分会会长一眼，哪里不知道这老家伙在想什么。
“大白现在到你出场了，等会给你提升下修为，我也要实验一下自己的想法！”
“谢谢主人，谢谢主人，您对我真是太好了。
呜呜～”
大白抱着青墨的小腿，一把鼻涕一把泪。

“行了哭什么哭，等会有你哭的，现在赶紧从我小腿上下来，你的鼻涕眼泪敢擦在我裤子上，今晚我就把你干锅了”
（╬??д??╬）
听到青墨这样说，大白立马把快流出来的鼻涕又吸回鼻子里，听到之前青墨在拍卖会的话，它可不想走捷径。
“系统，给我弄一份瞬间恢复灵力和伤势的丹方，赶紧的！”
“卧槽，你当我是收废品的啊？我的丹方都是高级的，哪里有合适他们这种低境界的啊？没有。”
“那穿越别的世界，帮你偷世界本源的事，别叫我了。
最近挺忙的，我还要赶着继承魏武雄风呢！
没空。”
“你等会，我找找看o（*≧д≦）o!!”
“赶紧的！
（≧ω≦）”
“有了，有了这个《回灵复气丹》合适他们用，炼神以上天穹以下，两秒内恢复满血满蓝，哪怕是致命伤也能让人多活两天。”
“嗯，就它了”
“这《回灵复气丹》能让人一息之内恢复全部灵力治疗一切外伤，哪怕身中致命伤也能让人多撑三日。
content_en:
The words spoken by the disciples who received him all stimulated the nerves of the branch president. Especially when the second elder heard what his son had done, he knew that the president would never let him go. Finally, they heard that Shi Siming actually wanted this heavenly master to accompany him for one night? The second elder almost fainted on the spot.
"It doesn't make sense, it really doesn't make sense!
How could such a scum appear in our alchemist association? "
"Second Elder, this is the good son you taught!"
The branch president whipped the second elder directly into the ruins on the spot. The second elder vomited blood and did not dare to delay for a moment. He flew directly in front of Liu Yurou and kowtowed desperately.
The remaining bad-tempered masters also ran to Liu Yurou to apologize.
"Why do you need those rules and regulations if an apology is useful? It's up to you!"
Shi Siming never dreamed that he would offend such a big boss and even want a beauty from the Sky Realm to spend one night with him.
The president of the branch personally killed Shi Siming on the spot. The second elder and the remaining Shi Siming's lackeys were deprived of their cultivation and expelled from the Alchemist Association.
"Hurry and get all the medicinal materials that senior needs. This is the Liyang wood you want, senior. Those medicinal materials and Liyang wood are given to senior for free as an apology from our Alchemist Association. If you have any other needs, senior, just tell us and we will do our best to satisfy you!"
The president of the branch wants to do his best to satisfy Qing Mo's request. He just hopes that he can calm down. It would be better if he can form a good relationship again!
"One yard for another, I will not take your medicinal materials in vain, and I will give you not a single piece of spiritual stone less. As for this Liyang wood!"
I will give you a pill recipe in exchange. "
"I don't dare, I don't dare. This is originally the fault of our Alchemist Association. This is what we should do."
"Okay, stop being so nagging, just do what I say!"
Qing Mo gave the branch president a blank look, wondering what the old guy was thinking.
"Dabai, it's your turn now. I'll improve your cultivation later. I also want to try out my own ideas!"
"Thank you, master, thank you, master, you are so kind to me.
Woohoo~"
Dabai hugged Qingmo's calf and burst into tears.
"Okay, why are you crying? You will cry later. Now get off my calves. If you dare to wipe your snot and tears on my pants, I will fuck you tonight."
(╬??д??╬)
Hearing what Qing Mo said, Dabai immediately sucked the snot that was about to flow back into his nose. After hearing what Qing Mo said at the auction, it didn't want to take shortcuts.
"System, get me a prescription for instant recovery of spiritual power and injuries. Hurry!"
"Damn it, do you think I'm a waste collector? My prescriptions are all high-level. Where can I find those suitable for their low level? None."
"As for traveling to other worlds and helping you steal the origin of the world, don't call me.
I've been very busy recently, and I'm rushing to inherit Wei Wu's heroic style!
Not available. "
"Wait a minute, I'll look for it o (*≧д≦) o!!"
“Hurry!
(≧ω≦)”
"Yes, with this "Resurrection Pill" suitable for them, it can restore full blood and mana within two seconds from the level of the God of Refining to the sky. Even if it is a fatal injury, it can allow people to live for two more days."
"Well, that's it."
"This "Rejuvenate Spirit Pill" can restore a person's full spiritual power within one breath and treat all external injuries. Even if the person is fatally injured, it can last for three more days.
